data.title: Dow Jones Futures: $100 Oil, Surging Yields Pressure Stocks With Fed Rate Hike Seen. Apple, Moderna Are New Buys.
data.description: Despite experiencing a bounce on Friday, the stock market faced challenges during the week due to rising Treasury yields and the price of oil hitting $100. This led to pressure on stocks as investors anticipated a potential Federal Reserve rate hike. In light of these conditions, it is suggested that Apple and Moderna could be promising investment opportunities.

data.title: SHAREHOLDER ALERT: Levi & Korsinsky, LLP Notifies Shareholders of an Investigation Concerning Possible Breaches of Fiduciary Duties by Certain Officers and Directors of Meridian Corporation (NASDAQ: MRBK).
data.description: Levi & Korsinsky has initiated an inquiry into Meridian Corporation (NASDAQ: MRBK) for potential breaches of fiduciary responsibilities. Shareholders of MRBK are urged to seek further details by contacting the firm. This investigation was launched as of September 11, 2026, in New York.

data.title: Omnis Energy: Judge Disqualifies HSF Kramer from Representing Pleasants Power Station in Bankruptcy Case
data.description: In Wilmington, Delaware, as of September 11, 2026, Young Conaway will continue to represent Pleasants Power Station as the U.S. Bankruptcy Court has removed HSF Kramer from the Chapter 11 proceedings. This decision comes following objections raised regarding the representation. The court-directed sale and challenges by Omnis are proceeding as planned. This development will impact the future of the power station and involves significant financial and legal implications.

data.title: Boo Bash Fall Festival to Make California Debut September 18, Bringing 100,000+ Square-Foot Immersive Pumpkin Patch to Escondido
data.description: A new fall attraction is coming to Mershops North County Mall in Escondido, California on September 11, 2026. This six-week event, named Boo Bash, will feature five unique zones and activities suitable for all age groups. It will offer a seasonal pumpkin patch and a family-oriented fall festival. This transformation promises to turn the mall into a popular destination for the season, providing a variety of entertainment options and immersive experiences.

data.title: Biohaven Investigation Notice: SueWallSt Notifies Investors of Pending Investigation Into Biohaven (BHVN)
data.description: On September 10, 2026, Biohaven Ltd (NYSE: BHVN) experienced a significant decrease in share value by almost 15% in one session. This decrease followed the FDA's decision to partially halt new-patient enrollment in the BHV-7000/opakalim epilepsy trials. Specifically, Biohaven shares plummeted by $2.21, representing approximately a 14.73% drop. This news impacted the market greatly, causing concern among investors about the future prospects of the company.

data.title: Cooper Companies Investigation Notice: Levi & Korsinsky Notifies Investors of Pending Investigation Into Cooper Companies (COO)
data.description: Cooper Companies has revised its fiscal 2026 projections for its Coopervision unit for the second consecutive quarter. Initially forecasting growth between 4.5-5.5%, the company now anticipates a much lower figure of 1-2%. The stock price of Cooper Companies (NASDAQ: COO) plummeted by almost 15% following this announcement. The revision reflects a significant decrease in the projected growth rate for Coopervision.

data.title: abrdn Global Infrastructure Income Fund (ASGI) Announces Transferable Rights Offering Terms
data.description: In Philadelphia on September 11, 2026, abrdn Global Infrastructure Income Fund (NYSE: ASGI) disclosed that its Board of Trustees has given the green light for the distribution of transferable rights ("Rights") to the Fund's common shareholders. This move permits shareholders to take advantage of the opportunity, with specific details of the issuance set and approved by the Board of Trustees.

data.title: Greenberg Traurig Advises Ryman Hospitality Properties on $1.38B Grande Lakes Orlando Resort Acquisition
data.description: In a recent deal dated September 11, 2026, Greenberg Traurig, LLP, a leading international law firm, acted as legal counsel for Ryman Hospitality Properties, Inc. (NYSE: RHP), a real estate investment trust (REIT) specializing in lodging, in their recent purchase of the complete ownership of the Grande Lakes Orlando Resort. This acquisition significantly adds to Ryman's portfolio, demonstrating their commitment to expansion in the hospitality sector.

data.title: NEW STUDY: WHITE MEMORIAL HOSPITALS GENERATE $1.2 BILLION IN ECONOMIC ACTIVITY AS L.A. HEALTHCARE SAFETY NET FACES GROWING PRESSURES
data.description: A recent study discovered that hospitals providing essential services to communities struggling with health, economic, and environmental challenges contribute to the employment of approximately 5,500 individuals. The research highlights the increasing financial difficulties faced by healthcare institutions, particularly those catering to high-need populations like Adventist Health White in Los Angeles.

data.title: Scholar Rock Announces FDA Approval of ISEMBYLD™ (apitegromab-mstn), the First and Only Muscle-Targeted Treatment for Children and Adults with Spinal Muscular Atrophy (SMA)
data.description: Scholar Rock, a biopharmaceutical company based in Cambridge, Massachusetts, has received FDA approval for ISEMBYLD (apitegromab-mstn) to treat spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) in adults and children over two years old who are already on SMN2-targeted therapy. This marks a significant advancement in addressing rare neuromuscular diseases, demonstrating the company's commitment to improving patient outcomes. With the approval, Scholar Rock aims to enhance the lives of individuals affected by SMA by leveraging its expertise in myostatin biology. The FDA's green light underscores the potential of ISEMBYLD as a viable treatment option for this debilitating condition, offering hope to patients and their families.

data.title: Treasure Trove Assembles the “Avengers of Collectibles” as Advisory Board
data.description: In New York, Treasure Trove, the collectibles holding company focused on creating the "Cultural Store of Value," revealed its advisory board, comprising industry powerhouses: Ken Goldin of Goldin, Jeremy Padawer, a passionate collector and investor, and Jim Halperin and Steve Ivy, the masterminds behind Heritage Auctions. Described as the "Avengers of the collectibles world" by AJ Scaramucci, Treasure Trove's founder, this lineup represents key figures in the field, each contributing vast expertise.

data.title: abrdn Healthcare Opportunities Fund (THQ) and abrdn World Healthcare Fund (THW) Announce New Managed Distribution Policies and Declare Monthly Distributions
data.description: On September 11, 2026, abrdn Healthcare Opportunities Fund (NYSE: THQ) and abrdn World Healthcare Fund (NYSE: THW) disclosed that the Board of Trustees has endorsed managed distribution policies for the Funds. Each Fund will have its independent policy aimed at ensuring regular distributions to investors. This decision means that investors can anticipate a consistent flow of income. It reflects the commitment to providing value to shareholders.

data.title: abrdn Income Credit Strategies Fund (ACP) Announces Change to Monthly Distribution Expected to Be Maintained for at Least the Next 12 Months
data.description: In Philadelphia on September 11, 2026, the abrdn Income Credit Strategies Fund (NYSE: ACP) disclosed a decrease in its monthly distribution, lowering it from $0.0775 to $0.055 per common share. This adjustment will take effect for the distribution scheduled for September 30, 2026, benefiting shareholders of the Fund.

data.title: Hydro One seeks approval from the Ontario Energy Board to build the North Shore Link
data.description: A new power line being constructed in northeast Toronto is anticipated to enhance the electricity system and boost economic development in the region. On September 11, 2026, Hydro One Networks Inc. (Hydro One) and Hydro One Sault Ste. Marie LP (HOSSM) jointly submitted an application to construct the line, aiming to bolster the infrastructure and facilitate growth. This initiative is seen as crucial in meeting the increasing power demands of the area, with the project expected to involve substantial investment and create numerous job opportunities.

data.title: abrdn Global Premier Properties Fund (AWP) Announces New Managed Distribution Policy and Declares Monthly Distribution
data.description: Philadelphia, September 11, 2026 - The abrdn Global Premier Properties Fund (NYSE: AWP) disclosed that its Board of Trustees has endorsed a managed distribution policy to offer shareholders a clear distribution structure. This strategy aims to provide an annualized payout rate of $0.25 per share, primarily through monthly distributions. The policy is intended to ensure shareholders receive consistent and predictable income distributions while maintaining the Fund's long-term performance objectives.

data.title: University of Phoenix College of Doctoral Studies announces 2026 Knowledge Without Boundaries Summit
data.description: A two-day virtual research summit scheduled for October 22-23 will delve into the theme of "Research as Sense-Making in Times of Uncertainty." The event will unite scholars, practitioners, and community partners from various fields. Taking place in Phoenix, the summit is organized by the University of Phoenix College of Doctoral Studies. This marks the 13th edition of the event, which aims to foster collaboration and knowledge sharing among participants.
